criterion: Acceptance: without an agent session the developer creates a worktree anywhere (AC-056, ADR-0004 requirements)
finding: Possible narrowing of developer freedom: the D-47 refusal of a `--dir` that climbs out of the short-name folder ignores the agent flag, so a developer's `--dir ../x` for a listed repository now exits 3
why: ask_placement in `dir` mode calls `placement.target_for` with no agent argument, so the new `refused` check applies to developers as well as agents, which the contract bullets (`Without an agent session, --parent works anywhere as today`) and SDD §3 (`developer anywhere`) do not sanction; D-47 weighs only unlisted repositories, and no test covers `agent=False` with `--dir ../up`.
fix: Gate the refusal on `afk_agent_session` (as the parent branch does), or record in D-47 that the developer's `--dir` is deliberately confined to the folder (the developer keeps `--parent`), and add an `agent=False` case to scripts/tests/test_create_worktree_placement.py.
evidence: scripts/create-worktree:383-385 `place "$([[ -n "$NAME" ]] && echo name || echo dir)" "$DIR_NAME"` / `[[ "$P_STATE" != refused ]] || refuse_exit "worktree folder: $P_REASON - pass a plain folder name as --dir"`; scripts/create-worktree:313-316 the non-parent branch of ask_placement never reads `agent`; the new test (test_a_dir_that_climbs_out_of_the_folder_refuses_with_exit_3) uses the default `agent=True`. Reachability not run; found by reading.

finding: Possible sibling-path gap: the marker is remade only when the short-name folder is absent, not when it exists empty and unmarked
why: R-06 lets an empty unmarked folder pass, the `-d` test then skips `claim_short_name_folder`, git fills the folder, and the next creation is refused by R-06 as 'was not made by setup' - the same failure D-48 set out to remove (found by reading; not run).
fix: Test for the marker file (or always call the idempotent claim) instead of `-d` on the folder, and add a test with an empty unmarked folder.
evidence: scripts/create-worktree:605 `[[ "$PLACED" != true || -d "$WORKTREE_PARENT" ]] || claim_short_name_folder`; scripts/placement.py:166-173 `held is None` + `empty = not any(os.scandir(folder))` -> `return None if empty else f"{folder} was not made by setup ..."`; scripts/repo_list.py:`_claim` returns early only when `held == main`, so a claim on an empty folder would write the marker

finding: The r-010 fix (marker-bearing remake of a removed short-name folder) covers only the --name/--dir branch; agent --parent mode still makes it unmarked
why: Parent mode never sets PLACED (create-worktree:363 sets it false, only line 387 in the name/dir branch sets it true), so line 605 skips claim_short_name_folder and line 606 `mkdir -p "$WORKTREE_PARENT"` makes <root>/<short name> with no marker, and the next creation is refused by R-06.
fix: Run claim_short_name_folder in parent mode too when the verdict is inside and the short-name folder (P_FOLDER) is missing, or refuse with a `run /afk:setup` line; add a test for --branch --dir --parent <root>/<short name> after the folder is removed by hand.
evidence: create-worktree:605-606 `[[ "$PLACED" != true || -d "$WORKTREE_PARENT" ]] || claim_short_name_folder` / `mkdir -p "$WORKTREE_PARENT"`; scripts/placement.py:161-173 `_short_name_folder` passes an absent folder, then refuses a non-empty unmarked one; the new test test_a_removed_short_name_folder_is_made_again_with_its_marker uses only --name. Failing input: listed repo, agent session, `rm -rf <root>/proj`, `--branch b --dir d --base dev --parent <root>/proj` (exit 0, unmarked proj), then `--name x` exits 3 with R-06. Found by reading; not run.

finding: Possible weak oracle remains: the r-006 fix adds a 4-string crash deny-list, still no positive anchor per case
why: A member that fails identically on both twins with any other text (argparse usage error, 'No such file or directory', rc 2 or 127) still passes, and a writing member whose change sets are both empty still passes.
fix: Add an expected rc or expected marker per case family (or assert rc is in an allowed set for outcome() members), and assert the change set is non-empty for writes=True cases.
evidence: CRASHES = ("Traceback (most recent call last)", ": command not found", "SyntaxError", "unexpected failure near line"); observe_pairs line 909 only calls crash_in(in_value); line 911 `assert out_value == expected` with expected = in_value; line 925 `assert out_changes == in_changes` passes when both are empty; outcome() (line 293) returns the rc but nothing asserts it

finding: claim_short_name_folder catches only RepositoryListError, so a busy list lock ends in a Python traceback
why: safe_write.update_locked raises SafeWriteError (not an OSError, not a RepositoryListError) when the list's lock stays held past 2 s or the file changes mid-write, and repo_list._update_list converts only OSError.
fix: Add `safe_write.SafeWriteError` to the except clause: `except (repo_list.RepositoryListError, repo_list.safe_write.SafeWriteError) as error:` so the caller sees one `sys.exit` line.
evidence: create-worktree:358 `except repo_list.RepositoryListError as error:`; scripts/safe_write.py:47 `class SafeWriteError(Exception)`; scripts/safe_write.py:20 docs 'refuses with SafeWriteError ... when the lock stays held past LOCK_WAIT_SECONDS'; scripts/repo_list.py:388-390 `except OSError as error: raise RepositoryListError(...)`. Failing input: a listed repository, missing short-name folder, and a concurrent writer holding the list lock for more than 2 s. The creator still exits 1 through error_exit at line 341, but a raw traceback goes to stderr first (found by reading; not run).

finding: The D-47 refusal is tested with one agent input only; no value that stays inside the folder and no developer run
why: The new `P_STATE != refused` check sits on a comparison with an edge (a `..` that resolves back inside <root>/<short name>); only `../up` is covered, so a regression that refuses every `..` or none of the non-agent runs is not pinned.
fix: Add a case for `--dir ../proj/x` (resolves inside, must succeed or refuse as D-47 states) and one for the same `--dir ../up` with agent=False asserting the documented outcome.
evidence: create-worktree lines 404-405 `[[ "$P_STATE" != refused ]] || refuse_exit "worktree folder: $P_REASON - pass a plain folder name as --dir"`; test line 332-335 uses `--dir ../up` with the default agent=True only

finding: claim_short_name_folder has only its success path tested
why: The new failure branch (entry no longer listed, or the claim raising RepositoryListError) exits 1 with 'could not be made with its marker - run /afk:setup' and is never exercised, so a regression there goes unseen.
fix: Add a case that removes the short-name folder and the list entry (or makes the claim fail), then asserts exit 1, that message, and assert_nothing_made.
evidence: scripts/create-worktree:374-375 `|| error_exit "worktree folder $WORKTREE_PARENT could not be made with its marker - run /afk:setup"`; test lines 345-353 cover only the listed, folder-removed success case

finding: The 'no case covers it whole' assertion in the EXCLUDED test is vacuous for suffixed keys
why: Member names are bare paths or '+'-joined paths, so a key such as 'scripts/afk-move.py (typing)' can never equal one; the check only catches an exact string match.
fix: Compare path = key.split(' (')[0] against the members' split('+') parts, allowing the documented partial-coverage keys through a separate marker, or drop the second assertion.
evidence: line 929-933: `members = {case.member for case in CASES}` ... `assert key not in members, key`, while EXCLUDED keys include 'scripts/afk-move.py (typing)' (line 51) and the case member is 'scripts/afk-move.py' (line 645)
